info.title: Research Intelligence backend — endpoints requested by the frontend
info.description: Generated from the zod contract schemas (src/lib/bff/*/schema.ts) by scripts/contract-spec.ts. Do not edit by hand.

get.summary: Workspace-scoped, paginated scorecard: papers with signal_score and resolved dimensions inline. Port reference: src/lib/papers/map.ts + src/lib/bff/papers/compose.ts.
One paper in the scorecard shape, with its workspace summary.

post.summary: Same endpoint plus: id: lines, ": ping" heartbeats every 15s, a `citations` event for workspace-scope answers ({paper_id, title, signal_score}), problem+json error payloads, and generation cancelled when the client disconnects.

get.summary: Same endpoint, paginated and scoped to the OWNER (not all workspace members).

patch.summary: Make PATCH {title} actually save (the current serializer is all-read-only, so it silently no-ops).

get.summary: One briefing edition per completed pipeline run, newest first, with model-written title/in_brief. Reference composition: src/lib/bff/briefings/service.ts; prose starting point: build_pipeline_run_digest_payload (tasks/auxiliary/email_digest.py).
One edition (latest run of that day) including the screening exclusions.
The calling user's notification preference in this workspace (PUT to change). Backend mapping suggestion: a per-user Subscriber row / is_active.

Read-only: the workspace's signal_score_code snippet (currently unserialized), its variables, and a structured weights list kept alongside the code. Users never edit — the formula stays backend-owned.
Same endpoint, paginated ({count,next,previous,results}) with ?ordering=. Low priority.
